# Every Go test, by package or by top-level test, and whether its behaviour can differ by OS ("os") or not ("any"),
# with the evidence in the code. A pull request runs on macOS only the os tests, beside pm's darwin build; a push to
# main runs every test there, and Linux runs every test on both. A package row ("*") covers each of its tests;
# a package whose tests differ has one row per test. go_os_tests.py check fails on a test in no row or in two.
# Columns: package dir, test or *, os or any, the evidence.
.                  *                                                                                  any assets_test.go:TestAssetsBuildWithNoEntryFiles runs `go build` on copied embed files and size_test.go:TestPackagesStayUnderTheSizeCap counts lines; neither touches an OS-specific API
internal/ask       *                                                                                  os  every Ask call goes through proc.Run with Group:true (Setpgid plus kill(-pgid)) on /bin/sh fakes; TestATimeoutKillsTheWholeCall checks the group kill with syscall.Kill(pid,0)
internal/cli/parse *                                                                                  any parse_test.go:TestArgumentChecks only parses argv in memory
internal/config    *                                                                                  any config_test.go:TestConfigTextKeepsEveryKey round-trips TOML text and compares the two reads; the git init only makes the temp dir a repo
internal/design    *                                                                                  any Check and Waivers are pure; MainFiles, MergeFiles and Own run git plumbing (ls-tree, rev-list, diff --name-only, log) and compare repo-relative names only, with no absolute paths, realpath or locks
internal/hooks     *                                                                                  any chunking, transcript JSONL parsing, hook JSON I/O, and a /bin/sh fake Self read through proc.Run without process groups (prime_test.go:fakeSelf)
internal/item      *                                                                                  any item_test.go:TestTheItemReadersLinkNoDolt only checks `go list` deps
internal/store     *                                                                                  os  every test uses store.Lock (syscall.Flock), clone() with filepath.EvalSymlinks on a temp dir, git subprocesses, or os.Chmod(p, 0) (TestApplyNeverOverwritesARecordItCannotRead)
